title: Peak Bagger Logbook Printable, Colorado 14ers Checklist, NH 48 4000 Footers, Adirondack 46 High Peaks Tracker, Hiker Gift, Summit Log PDF
description:
A summit logbook for three of the best-known US peak lists. Color in a progress board for each list and fill in a log card for every peak you climb. Print the whole book or only the list you are working on.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Gift page and how to use the logbook
- Honest safety basics for big peaks: start early, afternoon storms, turnaround time, official forecasts, Leave No Trace
- Colorado 14ers: about the list, a progress board for all 58 named peaks by range, and a log card for every peak
- New Hampshire 4,000-Footers: about the list, a progress board for all 48 peaks, and a log card for every peak
- Adirondack High Peaks: about the list and its trailless peaks, a progress board for all 46, and a log card for every peak
- Log cards: date, route and trailhead, times, partners, weather, notes, summit or turned back, winter, solo
- Winter round tracker and a blank board for your own list
- Summit photo pages, trip notes and a summit day gear check
- Certificate of completion and a sources page

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Elevations in feet and meters, checked against the list keepers' published lists in November 2026. A logbook, not a route guide: check official land manager and weather sources before every hike. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any peak list club; register your finish with each club yourself. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
